nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs on pull requests targeting main or develop, validating both the frontend and backend packages with format, type, Prisma schema, and build checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Two parallel jobs (frontend-quality, backend-quality) each run yarn install, format check, type check, and build in their respective package directories; the backend job adds a Prisma schema validation step.

nodes.name: frontend-quality
nodes.summary: CI job that checks out the repo, installs frontend dependencies, and runs format, type-check, and build steps for the Rolliude-front package.

nodes.name: backend-quality
nodes.summary: CI job that checks out the repo, installs backend dependencies, and runs format, type-check, Prisma schema validation, and build steps for the Rolliude-backend package.
